growth.title: Kuwait awards PPP deal to build digital telecom network
growth.description: Kuwait has selected Bahrain’s Beyon Group to develop the country’s fixed telecommunications network through a public-private partnership (PPP). The project is one of the largest digital infrastructure initiatives in Kuwait, with total investment expected at around KD825 million ($2.7 billion) over the 50-year partnership term, Beyon said in a statement.
